_doc: Reader on the pessimistic Plus profile with 2 % of hal_i2c transfers timing out (--i2c-faults 0.02). The panel power driver (drivers/board/metalio_epd_power.c) must recover by its retries, as the factory firmware did once on the device (docs/hardware/2026-11-03-phase0.md, section 6). Latency is not judged here: every retry costs about 0.25 s.

i2c.timeouts.why: the injected faults must actually reach the panel power path

display.pmic.retries.why: at least one power-up needed a retry, so the retry path ran

display.power_failures.why: every power-up recovers within 3 retries (otherwise the device would enter safe mode)

display.unpowered_waveforms.why: no waveform may start without good rails and VCOM

display.pmic.order_warnings.why: power-down order: XOE low >= 12 us before the rails go off, PWRUP before WAKEUP

display.pmic.vcom_mismatches.why: VCOM driven at the panel's value

warnings.count.why: retries are expected; a simulator warning is not
